noProjectsDescription: A project holds tasks and tracks them on a board or in a table until they are done.

createDialog.title: Create project
createDialog.description: Give the project a name, optional description, and owning initiative.
createDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Share context to help the initiative prioritize.
createDialog.disableTemplateHint: Disable “Save as template” to pick a template.
createDialog.saveAsTemplateHint: Template projects live under the Templates tab and can be reused to spin up new work.

detail.notFoundDescription: This project may have been deleted or you may have followed a broken link.
detail.noAccessDescription: You don’t have permission to view this project. Ask a project manager to grant you access.

overview.templateInfo: This project is a template. Use it to create new projects from the Templates tab.
overview.archivedInfo: This project is archived. Unarchive it from settings to add or update tasks.

assignee.emptyMessage: Invite initiative members to assign tasks.

statuses.description: Reorder, rename, or change category for the task columns used by this project.
statuses.noManagePermission: Only project managers can modify task statuses. Contact a project manager if you need changes.
statuses.deleteDescription: Deleting “{{name}}” moves any tasks in it to another status. Pick where they should land, or leave it to the project’s default.
statuses.onlyStatus: This is the project’s only status, and a board needs somewhere to put a task.

taskTypes.description: Types are the kinds of task this project holds, like a bug or an idea. Each has its own icon, color and page. New tasks start as the default type.
taskTypes.noManagePermission: Only people who can edit this project can change its types.
taskTypes.limitReached: A project can have up to {{max}} types.
taskTypes.pagesOnWiderScreen: A type's page is edited on a wider screen. Open this page on a tablet or a computer.
taskTypes.addDescription: Pick a ready-made type, start blank, or copy one this project has.
taskTypes.startFromLabel: Or start from one of this project's types
taskTypes.startFromHint: The new type starts with this type's icon, color and page. You can change them afterwards.
taskTypes.deleteDescription: Deleting “{{name}}” also deletes its page. Its tasks are kept and become the type you pick.
taskTypes.onlyType: This is the project's only type, and every task needs one.

gallery.blankHint: A plain page and a plain look, to make your own.
gallery.fieldsNotPlaced: {{name}} was added, but its fields couldn't be placed on its page. Add them with Edit page.

startsWith.title: A new {{name}} starts with
startsWith.description: Whatever is left empty when a task of this type is made starts as this. Anything the person fills in is kept.
startsWith.descriptionPlaceholder: An outline to fill in, for example
startsWith.repeatHint: A repeat starts only on a task that has a start or due date.
startsWith.saved: Saved what new tasks start with

copy.title: Copy types from another project
copy.description: Each comes with its icon, color, page and what a new task of it starts with.
copy.noRoom: This project already has as many types as it can.

tasks.enterTooltip: Hit ‘enter’ to create a new task
tasks.ganttEmpty: No tasks to show. Add one, or clear the filters.
tasks.ganttSchedule: Drag across the days to give this task dates
tasks.ganttLink: Drag onto another task to link the two
tasks.ganttBlockedByHint: Can't start until that task is done
tasks.ganttPartOfHint: Becomes one of that task's parts
tasks.ganttChainTitle: Move what waits on it too?
tasks.ganttChain_one: {{count}} task waits on “{{title}}”. Move it later by as many days?
tasks.ganttChain_other: {{count}} tasks wait on “{{title}}”. Move them later by as many days?
tasks.ganttKeys: Up and down move between tasks, right and left open and fold a task's parts, and Enter opens a task.
tasks.ganttKeysMove: Up and down move between tasks, right and left open and fold a task's parts, and Enter opens a task. Alt with left or right moves a task a day; with Shift as well, just its due date.
tasks.archiveDialogDescription: This will archive {{count}} task. Archived tasks are hidden by default but can be shown using the filter.
tasks.archiveDialogDescription_other: This will archive {{count}} tasks. Archived tasks are hidden by default but can be shown using the filter.
tasks.createError: Unable to create task. Please try again once statuses load.
tasks.bulkUpdateError: Unable to update tasks right now.
tasks.bulkDeleteError: Unable to delete tasks right now.

table.moveError: Couldn't move the task to that group.
table.manualSortDisabled: Manual sorting disabled, <1>reset column sorting and row grouping</1> to reorder.

recurrence.strategyOnScheduleDescription: A new task is created on a fixed schedule based on dates.
recurrence.strategyAfterCompletionDescription: A new task is created a fixed interval after the previous one is completed.

mode.set: The first or last of chosen days

recurrence.hourlyCompletionHelp: Each completion schedules the next task after the selected number of hours. Leave the maximum blank to repeat continuously. With a maximum, reaching it or crossing midnight starts the next day at the first task’s time, delayed if needed to preserve the gap. Daily counts use the timezone of the person completing the task.
recurrence.limitInvalid: Not saved. Enter a whole daily maximum from 1 to 24, or leave it blank for no limit.
recurrence.hourlyNeedsDueDate: Set a due date and time for the first task before saving an hourly repeat.

quickActions.assignError: Couldn't change who's on this task.

metadata.description: What this project's tasks can hold beside the initiative's properties. A task moved to another project keeps a value only where that project has metadata of the same name and type.
metadata.deleteBody: This removes it and every task's value of it in this project.
